classification_contract.definition: Measure latest reported gross margin (GrossProfit/revenue) minus the same fiscal window one year earlier. Anchor to latest canonical revenue end and shortest explicitly reported duration on a tied end, before requiring current profit or comparators. Require exact month-aligned 3/6/9/12-month windows and same currency; YTD compares identical YTD windows. Missing current/prior gross profit or revenue, zero revenue, unresolved required-window conflicts, stale current periods, unsupported stubs or 52/53-week calendars are unavailable; never replace the latest anchor with an older complete pair. Numeric change >=0.08 is positive, <=-0.02 negative, otherwise neutral; categories describe this measurement, not future returns. Preserve full literal operands and evidence. Default current freshness is 550 days; absolute change above 2 has partial coverage and confidence 0.5 without changing the measurement.

execution.contract:
With period_policy=same_window_yoy, measure latest GrossProfit/revenue minus
    the same reported fiscal window's margin one year earlier. Require exact
    month-aligned 3/6/9/12-month windows, matching currency and latest revenue anchor;
    no older complete fallback or unresolved conflicts. Missing current profit or
    any comparator is unavailable. Unknown explicit policies are unavailable.
    Without period_policy preserve legacy behavior: latest margin minus the previous
    comparable-duration margin. GrossProfit and revenue must match start, end and units
    within each period, and revenue comes from the per-issuer canonical total series
    (dominance-resolved; partial or zero same-period tag values never displace the
    total). Missing matched periods, zero revenue or stale current facts yield
    unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default
    positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is
    negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. Values beyond
    plausible_abs_max (default 2) are downgraded to partial coverage at 0.5 confidence
    with an implausible_value marker. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current
    SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.

numeric_measurement.formula: current gross profit / revenue - same fiscal window prior-year gross profit / revenue

measurement_context.period_rule: Use the exact reported start/end duration; fiscal-period labels do not turn a cumulative duration into one quarter. Keep a computed return with its own dated price anchors.
